WITH candidates AS (
  SELECT parent_key
  FROM "drugbank_drugs_attachments"
  GROUP BY parent_key
  HAVING 
    SUM(CASE WHEN lower(title) LIKE '%ema summary of product characteristics%' AND lower(title) LIKE '%retacrit%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
    AND
    SUM(CASE 
          WHEN lower(title) LIKE '%fda news release%' AND lower(title) LIKE '%epoetin alfa biosimilar%' THEN 1
          WHEN lower(title) LIKE '%fda approves first epoetin alfa biosimilar%' THEN 1
          ELSE 0
        END) > 0
)
SELECT 
  c.parent_key AS drugbank_id,
  COALESCE(
    (SELECT synonym FROM "drugbank_drug_syn" s 
     WHERE s.drugbank_id = c.parent_key AND lower(s.language) LIKE '%english%' AND s.coder = 'inn/usan' 
     LIMIT 1),
    (SELECT synonym FROM "drugbank_drug_syn" s 
     WHERE s.drugbank_id = c.parent_key AND lower(s.language) LIKE '%english%' 
     LIMIT 1)
  ) AS drug_name
FROM candidates c
LIMIT 50;

WITH textbook_refs AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM "drugbank_drugs_links"
  WHERE LOWER(COALESCE(title, '')) LIKE '%textbook%'
     OR LOWER(COALESCE(url, '')) LIKE '%textbook%'
),
-- Try to find AHFS codes in synonyms (if present). If none found, fall back to ATC codes as best available proxy.
ahfs1 AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT synonym) AS cnt
  FROM "drugbank_drug_syn"
  WHERE LOWER(COALESCE(coder, '')) LIKE '%ahfs%'
),
ahfs2 AS (

  FROM "drugbank_drug_atc_codes"
),
ahfs_codes AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT cnt FROM ahfs1) > 0 THEN (SELECT cnt FROM ahfs1)
              ELSE (SELECT cnt FROM ahfs2)
         END AS cnt
)
SELECT
  tr.cnt AS textbook_reference_count,
  ac.cnt AS unique_ahfs_pharmacologic_codes_count,
  CASE WHEN tr.cnt > ac.cnt THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_textbook_count_greater,
  CASE WHEN tr.cnt > ac.cnt THEN tr.cnt - ac.cnt ELSE 0 END AS greater_by
FROM textbook_refs tr
CROSS JOIN ahfs_codes ac
LIMIT 50;

  FROM "drugbank_carriers_polypeptides_pfams" p

links_scored AS (
  SELECT l.parent_key AS drugbank_id,
         l.title,
         CASE
           WHEN l.title LIKE '%Pharma%' THEN 3
           WHEN l.title LIKE '%Pharmaceutical%' THEN 3
           WHEN l.title LIKE '%Therapeutic%' THEN 2
           WHEN l.title LIKE '%Laborator%' THEN 2
           WHEN l.title LIKE '%Inc%' THEN 1
           WHEN l.title LIKE '%Ltd%' THEN 1
           WHEN l.title LIKE '%LLC%' THEN 1
           WHEN l.title LIKE '%GmbH%' THEN 1
           WHEN l.title LIKE '%S.A.%' THEN 1
           WHEN l.title LIKE '%Co.%' THEN 1
           ELSE 0
         END AS score
  FROM "drugbank_drugs_links" l
),
chosen_links AS (
  SELECT drugbank_id, title AS manufacturer
  FROM (
    SELECT drugbank_id, title,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY drugbank_id ORDER BY score DESC, title) AS rn
    FROM links_scored
  ) x
  WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT sp.drugbank_id, cl.manufacturer, sp.pfam_id AS serum_albumin_pfam_id
FROM serum_pfam sp
LEFT JOIN chosen_links cl ON cl.drugbank_id = sp.drugbank_id
LIMIT 50;

WITH prav AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT parent_key
  FROM "drugbank_drugs_links"
  WHERE lower(title) LIKE '%pravastatin%'
  LIMIT 1

  FROM "drugbank_carriers" c

  WHERE lower(s.description) LIKE '%smaller reduction in ldl%'

  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT carriers.human_carrier_proteins, snp.gene_symbol, snp.rs_id, snp.description
FROM carriers
JOIN snp ON snp.parent_key = carriers.parent_key
LIMIT 50;
